use default

totient(value: int) -> int is
    let remaining mut = value
    let count mut = value
    let factor mut = 2

    while factor * factor <= remaining do
        if remaining % factor == 0 then
            while remaining % factor == 0 do
                remaining = remaining / factor
            od

            count = count - count / factor
        fi

        factor = factor + 1
    od

    if remaining > 1 then
        count = count - count / remaining
    fi

    count
si

totient_sum(value: int) -> int is
    let total mut = 0
    let current mut = value

    while current > 1 do
        current = totient(current)
        total = total + current
    od

    total

perfect_totients(count: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 1
    let found mut = 0

    while found < count do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        if totient_sum(candidate) == candidate then
            found = found + 1
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
